steps.tx: **CKD-MBD**, or chronic kidney disease **mineral and bone disorder**, is a systemic disorder encompassing biochemical derangements of calcium, phosphorus, PTH, or vitamin D, osteodystrophy bone turnover abnormalities, and extensive cardiovascular **vascular calcification**. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients.

steps.tx: The pathogenesis of **secondary hyperparathyroidism** begins early in CKD with renal phosphate retention and rising osteocyte **FGF23** secretion, which suppresses renal **1-alpha-hydroxylase** to cause profound **calcitriol** deficiency. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients. Structured clinical management and regular follow-up help guide therapeutic optimization and prevent disease complications.

steps.tx: **KDIGO** clinical guidelines suggest maintaining serum intact **parathyroid hormone**, or **iPTH**, levels in end-stage kidney disease on hemodialysis, designated as **CKD G5D**, in the target range of **2** to **9** times the assay upper normal limit, typically **130** to **600** pg/mL. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients.

steps.tx: Non-calcium-based phosphate binders, including **sevelamer** carbonate, **lanthanum** carbonate, and **sucroferric oxyhydroxide**, prevent positive calcium balance and significantly attenuate progression of **coronary calcification** compared with calcium acetate. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients. Structured clinical management and regular follow-up help guide therapeutic optimization and prevent disease complications.

left.title: Non-Calcium Binders
points: Calcium balance: Neutral calcium balance without loading
Cardiovascular effect: Significantly attenuates vascular calcification
Lipid effect: Sevelamer binds bile acids and lowers LDL

right.title: Calcium-Based Binders
points: Calcium balance: Positive calcium load and accumulation
Cardiovascular effect: Accelerates medial arterial calcification
Cost profile: Low-cost but higher hypercalcemia risk

steps.tx: **Calcimimetics**, including oral **cinacalcet** and intravenous **etelcalcetide**, allosterically modulate the **calcium-sensing receptor** on parathyroid chief cells, suppressing PTH secretion while simultaneously lowering serum calcium and phosphorus concentrations. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients. Structured clinical management and regular follow-up help guide therapeutic optimization and prevent disease complications.

steps.tx: **Adynamic bone disease** is a **low-turnover bone** disorder characterized by markedly depressed **osteoblast** and osteoclast activity and low bone formation, associated with **oversuppression** of PTH with iPTH under **100** pg/mL, carrying high fracture risk. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients.

left.title: Adynamic Bone Disease
points: Bone turnover: Markedly reduced low-turnover rate
Cellular activity: Striking absence of osteoblasts and osteoclasts
Management: Withhold calcimimetics and reduce calcium binders

right.title: Osteitis Fibrosa Cystica
points: Bone turnover: Markedly accelerated high-turnover rate
PTH level: Excessively elevated iPTH > 600 pg/mL
Cellular activity: Abundant osteoclasts with marrow fibrosis
Management: Intensify calcimimetics and vitamin D analogues

steps.tx: **Calciphylaxis**, also termed **calcific uremic arteriolopathy**, is a life-threatening syndrome of medial arteriolar calcification, endovascular fibrosis, and **microthrombosis** resulting in **ischemic ulcers** and necrotic subcutaneous plaques. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients. Structured clinical management and regular follow-up help guide therapeutic optimization and prevent disease complications.

steps.tx: Medical management of **calciphylaxis** centers on intravenous **sodium thiosulfate** dosed at **25** g infused post-dialysis **3** times weekly, aggressive **wound care**, cessation of calcium binders and warfarin, and reducing calcium-phosphorus product. Systematic diagnostic evaluation and careful monitoring remain vital for preserving optimal clinical outcomes in these patients.
